+  let incomplete = omitted || limit < output.length()
+  Some(
+    diagnostic_text(
+      @utf8.decode_lossy(output[:limit]),
+      environment~,
+      omitted=incomplete,
+      protected_values=safeguards.values,
+      incomplete_final_line=incomplete && output[limit - 1] != b'\n',
+    ),
+  )
+}
+
+///|
+async fn diagnostic_capture(
+  reader : @process.ReadFromProcess,
+  limit : Int32,
+) -> (Bytes, Bool) {
+  let output = @buffer.Buffer(size_hint=if limit < 4096 { limit } else { 4096 })
+  let mut truncated = false
+  while reader.read_some(max_len=4096) is Some(chunk) {
+    let remaining = limit - output.length()
+    let count = if chunk.length() < remaining {
+      chunk.length()
+    } else {
+      remaining
+    }
+    if count > 0 {
+      output.write_bytes(chunk[:count])
+    }
+    if count < chunk.length() {
+      truncated = true
+    }
+  }
+  (output.to_bytes(), truncated)
+}
+
+///|
+async fn diagnostic_process_output(
+  program : String,
+  args : Array[String],
+  environment~ : Map[String, String],
+  cwd? : StringView,
+  stdin? : &@process.ProcessInput,
+  stdout_limit~ : Int32,
+  stderr_limit~ : Int32,
+) -> (Int32, Bytes, Bool, Bytes, Bool) {
+  let (out, stdout) = @process.read_from_process()
+  defer out.close()
+  let (err, stderr) = @process.read_from_process()
+  defer err.close()
+  @async.with_task_group(async fn(group) {
+    let child = @process.spawn(
+      group,
+      program,
+      args,
+      extra_env=environment,
+      inherit_env=false,
+      cwd?,
+      stdin?,
+      stdout~,
+      stderr~,
+    )
+    let output = group.spawn(async fn() {
+      diagnostic_capture(out, stdout_limit)
+    })
+    let errors = group.spawn(async fn() {
+      diagnostic_capture(err, stderr_limit)
+    })
+    let status = child.wait()
+    let (output, output_truncated) = output.wait()
+    let (errors, errors_truncated) = errors.wait()
+    (status, output, output_truncated, errors, errors_truncated)
+  })
+}

+async fn save_command_failure(
+  stage : String,

+  recording? : Bool,
+  phase? : String,
+) -> Unit {
+  if !recording.unwrap_or(

+  }
+  let cancelled = @async.is_being_cancelled()
+  let timeout = error is @async.TimeoutError
+  save_diagnostic(

+    if cancelled {

+    } else if timeout {
+      "timeout"
+    } else {

+    error_type=if cancelled {
+      "cancelled"

+    } else if error is InvalidConfig(_) {

+    } else if error is AdapterError(_) {
+      "adapter_error"
+    } else if error is @os_error.OSError(_, ..) {
+      "os_error"
+    } else {
+      "unexpected_error"
+    },
+    os_errno?=match error {
+      @os_error.OSError(code, ..) => Some(code)
+      _ => None
+    },

+    error_message=diagnostic_error(error),

    50	  Ready
    51	  WaitingForGitHelper
    52	  Retry(String)

    56	///|
    57	async fn relay_readiness(
    58	  state : Json,
    59	  directory : String,
    60	  git_enabled : Bool,
    61	  record_success~ : Bool,
    62	) -> RelayReadiness {
    63	  let script =
    64	    #|# orca-relay-readiness
    65	    #|set -eu
    66	    #|curl --disable --noproxy '*' --silent --max-time 1 --max-filesize 4096 --write-out '\n%{http_code}' http://localhost:12049/ready
    67	  let started = @env.now()
    68	  let environment = workspace_environment(state)
    69	  let evidence : Json = { "gitEnabled": git_enabled }
    70	  let mut phase = "readiness"
    71	  let mut exit_code = None
    72	  let mut error_detail = None
    73	  let mut cancelled = false
    74	  let result = @async.with_timeout(3000, async fn() {
    75	    let (code, output, output_truncated, stderr, stderr_truncated) = diagnostic_process_output(
    76	      workspace_program(state, "ssh"),
    77	      ssh_mux_options(state, directory) + [script],
    78	      environment~,
    79	      cwd?=workspace_directory(state).map(path => path[:]),
    80	      stdout_limit=8192,
    81	      stderr_limit=8192,
    82	    )
    83	    exit_code = Some(code)
    84	    if code != 0 {
    85	      error_detail = diagnostic_output(
    86	        stderr,
    87	        environment,
    88	        omitted=stderr_truncated,
    89	      )
    90	      return RelayReadiness::Retry(
    91	        if code == 28 {
    92	          "http_timeout"
    93	        } else {
    94	          "transport_error"
    95	        },
    96	      )
    97	    }
    98	    if output_truncated {
    99	      error_detail = Some(
   100	        "Readiness response exceeds the capture limit\n[error details incomplete or truncated]",
   101	      )
   102	      return RelayReadiness::Retry("response_too_large")
   103	    }
   104	    let text = @utf8.decode(output).trim().to_owned()
   105	    let lines = text.split("\n").to_array()
   106	    let status = lines.last().unwrap_or("").to_owned()
   107	    if status.length() == 3 && status.iter().all(c => c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
   108	      set_field(evidence, "httpStatus", Json::string(status))
   109	    }
   110	    if status == "404" {
   111	      return RelayReadiness::Unsupported
   112	    }
   113	    if status != "200" {
   114	      return RelayReadiness::Retry(
   115	        if status == "503" {
   116	          "http_503"
   117	        } else {
   118	          "http_error"
   119	        },
   120	      )
   121	    }
   122	    let body = text[:text.length() - status.length()]
   123	      .to_owned()
   124	      .trim()
   125	      .to_owned()
   126	    phase = "response"
   127	    let value = @json.parse(body) catch {
   128	      error => {
   129	        error_detail = Some(diagnostic_error(error, environment~))
   130	        return RelayReadiness::Retry("schema_invalid")
   131	      }
   132	    }
   133	    if field(value, "version") != Some(Json::number(1)) {
   134	      return RelayReadiness::Unsupported
   135	    }
   136	    if field(value, "owner") != field(state, "user") {
   137	      let progress = Progress::new("relay-probe", environment~)
   138	      for (name, source) in [("expectedOwner", state), ("observedOwner", value)] {
   139	        let key = if name == "expectedOwner" { "user" } else { "owner" }
   140	        if field(source, key) is Some(Json::String(owner)) {
   141	          set_field(
   142	            evidence,
   143	            name,
   144	            Json::string(
   145	              progress.safe_message(owner).unwrap_or("[unavailable]"),
   146	            ),
   147	          )
   148	        }
   149	      }
   150	      return RelayReadiness::Retry("owner_mismatch")
   151	    }
   152	    for name in ["host_owner", "instance"] {
   153	      if field(value, name) is Some(Json::String(value)) && value != "" {
   154	        continue
   155	      }
   156	      return RelayReadiness::Retry("schema_invalid")
   157	    }
   158	    if git_enabled {
   159	      phase = "git-helper"
   160	      let helper = "git config --global --get credential.helper | grep -F 'internal agent git-credentials' >/dev/null"
   161	      let (code, _, _, stderr, stderr_truncated) = diagnostic_process_output(
   162	        workspace_program(state, "ssh"),
   163	        ssh_mux_options(state, directory) + [helper],
   164	        environment~,
   165	        cwd?=workspace_directory(state).map(path => path[:]),
   166	        stdout_limit=0,
   167	        stderr_limit=8192,
   168	      )
   169	      exit_code = Some(code)
   170	      if code == 1 {
   171	        return RelayReadiness::WaitingForGitHelper
   172	      }
   173	      if code != 0 {
   174	        error_detail = diagnostic_output(
   175	          stderr,
   176	          environment,
   177	          omitted=stderr_truncated,
   178	        )
   179	        return RelayReadiness::Retry("transport_error")
   180	      }
   181	    }
   182	    RelayReadiness::Ready
   183	  }) catch {
   184	    @async.TimeoutError => RelayReadiness::Retry("ssh_timeout")
   185	    error => {
   186	      cancelled = @async.is_being_cancelled()
   187	      error_detail = Some(diagnostic_error(error, environment~))
   188	      RelayReadiness::Retry("transport_error")
   189	    }
   190	  }
   191	  match result {
   192	    Ready =>
   193	      if record_success {
   194	        save_diagnostic(
   195	          "relay-probe",
   196	          "success",
   197	          phase~,
   198	          duration_ms=(@env.now() - started).to_double(),
   199	          evidence~,
   200	          tunnel_directory=directory,
   201	          recording=state_recording(state),
   202	        )
   203	      }
   204	    WaitingForGitHelper =>
   205	      save_diagnostic(
   206	        "relay-probe",
   207	        "pending",
   208	        error_type="git_helper_unavailable",
   209	        phase~,
   210	        exit_code?,
   211	        evidence~,
   212	        duration_ms=(@env.now() - started).to_double(),
   213	        tunnel_directory=directory,
   214	        recording=state_recording(state),
   215	      )
   216	    Retry(reason) =>
   217	      save_diagnostic(
   218	        "relay-probe",
   219	        if cancelled {
   220	          "cancelled"
   221	        } else {
   222	          "failed"
   223	        },
   224	        error_type=if cancelled { "cancelled" } else { reason },
   225	        phase~,
   226	        exit_code?,
   227	        error_message?=error_detail,
   228	        timeout_ms?=if reason == "ssh_timeout" { Some(3000) } else { None },
   229	        evidence~,
   230	        duration_ms=(@env.now() - started).to_double(),
   231	        tunnel_directory=directory,
   232	        recording=state_recording(state),
   233	      )
   234	    Unsupported =>
   235	      save_diagnostic(
   236	        "relay-probe",
   237	        "unsupported",
   238	        error_type="readiness_unsupported",
   239	        phase~,
   240	        exit_code?,
   241	        evidence~,
   242	        tunnel_directory=directory,
   243	        recording=state_recording(state),
   244	      )
   245	  }

    49	priv enum RelayReadiness {
    50	  Ready
    51	  WaitingForGitHelper
    52	  Retry(String)

    56	///|
    57	async fn relay_readiness(
    58	  state : Json,
    59	  directory : String,
    60	  git_enabled : Bool,
    61	  record_success~ : Bool,
    62	) -> RelayReadiness {
    63	  let script =
    64	    #|# orca-relay-readiness
    65	    #|set -eu
    66	    #|curl --disable --noproxy '*' --silent --max-time 1 --max-filesize 4096 --write-out '\n%{http_code}' http://localhost:12049/ready
    67	  let started = @env.now()
    68	  let environment = workspace_environment(state)
    69	  let evidence : Json = { "gitEnabled": git_enabled }
    70	  let mut phase = "readiness"
    71	  let mut exit_code = None
    72	  let mut error_detail = None
    73	  let mut cancelled = false
    74	  let result = @async.with_timeout(3000, async fn() {
    75	    let (code, output, output_truncated, stderr, stderr_truncated) = diagnostic_process_output(
    76	      workspace_program(state, "ssh"),
    77	      ssh_mux_options(state, directory) + [script],
    78	      environment~,
    79	      cwd?=workspace_directory(state).map(path => path[:]),
    80	      stdout_limit=8192,
    81	      stderr_limit=8192,
    82	    )
    83	    exit_code = Some(code)
    84	    if code != 0 {
    85	      error_detail = diagnostic_output(
    86	        stderr,
    87	        environment,
    88	        omitted=stderr_truncated,
    89	      )
    90	      return RelayReadiness::Retry(
    91	        if code == 28 {
    92	          "http_timeout"
    93	        } else {
    94	          "transport_error"
    95	        },
    96	      )
    97	    }
    98	    if output_truncated {
    99	      error_detail = Some(
   100	        "Readiness response exceeds the capture limit\n[error details incomplete or truncated]",
   101	      )
   102	      return RelayReadiness::Retry("response_too_large")
   103	    }
   104	    let text = @utf8.decode(output).trim().to_owned()
   105	    let lines = text.split("\n").to_array()
   106	    let status = lines.last().unwrap_or("").to_owned()
   107	    if status.length() == 3 && status.iter().all(c => c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
   108	      set_field(evidence, "httpStatus", Json::string(status))
   109	    }
   110	    if status == "404" {
   111	      return RelayReadiness::Unsupported
   112	    }
   113	    if status != "200" {
   114	      return RelayReadiness::Retry(
   115	        if status == "503" {
   116	          "http_503"
   117	        } else {
   118	          "http_error"
   119	        },
   120	      )
   121	    }
   122	    let body = text[:text.length() - status.length()]
   123	      .to_owned()
   124	      .trim()
   125	      .to_owned()
   126	    phase = "response"
   127	    let value = @json.parse(body) catch {
   128	      error => {
   129	        error_detail = Some(diagnostic_error(error, environment~))
   130	        return RelayReadiness::Retry("schema_invalid")
   131	      }
   132	    }
   133	    if field(value, "version") != Some(Json::number(1)) {
   134	      return RelayReadiness::Unsupported
   135	    }
   136	    if field(value, "owner") != field(state, "user") {
   137	      let progress = Progress::new("relay-probe", environment~)
   138	      for (name, source) in [("expectedOwner", state), ("observedOwner", value)] {
   139	        let key = if name == "expectedOwner" { "user" } else { "owner" }
   140	        if field(source, key) is Some(Json::String(owner)) {
   141	          set_field(
   142	            evidence,
   143	            name,
   144	            Json::string(
   145	              progress.safe_message(owner).unwrap_or("[unavailable]"),
   146	            ),
   147	          )
   148	        }
   149	      }
   150	      return RelayReadiness::Retry("owner_mismatch")
   151	    }
   152	    for name in ["host_owner", "instance"] {
   153	      if field(value, name) is Some(Json::String(value)) && value != "" {
   154	        continue
   155	      }
   156	      return RelayReadiness::Retry("schema_invalid")
   157	    }
   158	    if git_enabled {
   159	      phase = "git-helper"
   160	      let helper = "git config --global --get credential.helper | grep -F 'internal agent git-credentials' >/dev/null"
   161	      let (code, _, _, stderr, stderr_truncated) = diagnostic_process_output(
   162	        workspace_program(state, "ssh"),
   163	        ssh_mux_options(state, directory) + [helper],
   164	        environment~,
   165	        cwd?=workspace_directory(state).map(path => path[:]),
   166	        stdout_limit=0,
   167	        stderr_limit=8192,
   168	      )
   169	      exit_code = Some(code)

   172	      }

   174	        error_detail = diagnostic_output(

   176	          environment,
   177	          omitted=stderr_truncated,

   221	        } else {
   222	          "failed"
   223	        },

   234	    Unsupported =>

   356	This requires the host `codex` CLI and managed ChatGPT file authentication. The

   358	credentials. It preserves manually changed remote authentication, does not support

    64	    #|# orca-relay-readiness
    65	    #|set -eu
    66	    #|curl --disable --noproxy '*' --silent --max-time 1 --max-filesize 4096 --write-out '\n%{http_code}' http://localhost:12049/ready
    67	  let started = @env.now()

    69	  let evidence : Json = { "gitEnabled": git_enabled }
    70	  let mut phase = "readiness"
    71	  let mut exit_code = None
    72	  let mut error_detail = None
    73	  let mut cancelled = false
    74	  let result = @async.with_timeout(3000, async fn() {
    75	    let (code, output, output_truncated, stderr, stderr_truncated) = diagnostic_process_output(
    76	      workspace_program(state, "ssh"),
    77	      ssh_mux_options(state, directory) + [script],
    78	      environment~,
    79	      cwd?=workspace_directory(state).map(path => path[:]),
    80	      stdout_limit=8192,
    81	      stderr_limit=8192,
    82	    )
    83	    exit_code = Some(code)
    84	    if code != 0 {
    85	      error_detail = diagnostic_output(
    86	        stderr,
    87	        environment,
    88	        omitted=stderr_truncated,
    89	      )
    90	      return RelayReadiness::Retry(
    91	        if code == 28 {
    92	          "http_timeout"
    93	        } else {
    94	          "transport_error"
    95	        },
    96	      )
    97	    }
    98	    if output_truncated {
    99	      error_detail = Some(
   100	        "Readiness response exceeds the capture limit\n[error details incomplete or truncated]",
   101	      )
   102	      return RelayReadiness::Retry("response_too_large")
   103	    }
   104	    let text = @utf8.decode(output).trim().to_owned()
   105	    let lines = text.split("\n").to_array()

   108	      set_field(evidence, "httpStatus", Json::string(status))

   119	        },
   120	      )
   121	    }

   124	      .trim()
   125	      .to_owned()

   131	      }
   132	    }

   134	      return RelayReadiness::Unsupported

   356	This requires the host `codex` CLI and managed ChatGPT file authentication. The
   357	addon refreshes when needed and forwards access/account data without refresh
   358	credentials. It preserves manually changed remote authentication, does not support
